svg.title: Why every edge touching a wait is redundant

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: B waits at W1 (B1). A0 left W1, so the rule adds A0 → B1. But B had to ENTER W1 first (B0), and the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: same rule already gave A0 → B0. Path A0 → B0 → B1 makes the red edge redundant.

g.text: (b) Edge OUT of a wait · Theorem 1

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: D enters W1 later (D2), so the rule adds B1 → D2 (B's wait 'leaves' W1). But B's next move B2 really

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: leaves W1, and gives B2 → D2. Path B1 → B2 → D2 makes the red edge redundant.

g.text: (c) So the waits can go: contract each lane

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: With every type-2 edge on B1 and D1 redundant, delete the two wait vertices and join the neighbours

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: with a type-1 edge. Here B0 → B2 and D0 → D2.

g.text: Only the GRAPH loses the wait. The robot still stands at W1: if X is slow, B simply

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: does not get the 'go' for B2 yet. The wait now emerges from the dependencies

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: instead of being a 1-step timer, so B can go the moment X2 is done.

g.text: B0 → D1 (B leaves W2, D waits at W2) is the third case; it is replaced by B0 → D0 → D1, exactly as in panel (a). All edges computed by scripts/adg/adg.py.

g.text: Wait actions (start = goal) appear in the original ADG of figure 2.4 with three type-2 edges: A0 → B1, B1 → D2 and B0 → D1. For each one, the paper shows that a path through a neighbouring

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: move already enforces the same order.
